title: Nextcloud or ownCloud: Self-Hosted File Sharing Compared
excerpt: Nextcloud began as a fork of ownCloud, and both let you run file sharing and collaboration on your own servers. They have since diverged in pace, community and enterprise focus.
verdict: Nextcloud is currently the more popular and faster-moving project and suits most self-hosting needs. ownCloud remains a sound option for enterprises that prioritise stability and specific compliance features.

spec1.label: Development pace and new features
spec1.device1Value: Adds features faster, with the larger community
spec1.device2Value: Slower, with a focus on enterprise stability

spec2.label: Ease of self-hosting
spec2.device1Value: Extensive documentation that beginners can follow
spec2.device2Value: Also good, but better suited to experienced teams

spec3.label: Advanced enterprise features
spec3.device2Value: Historically stronger on enterprise compliance features
